segments.effect: Compute monotonicity separately in segments split by immutable CAP cells; strength .5/1 interpolates the correction.
segments.cost: Additional row/column segment arithmetic per leaf; may weaken useful global ordering.

geometry.effect: Soft penalty for CAP geometry that constricts free-space mobility; strengths2000/4000. CAP tiles are never hard walls for legal moves.
geometry.cost: Extra board topology arithmetic per leaf; may over-penalize useful CAP positions.

risk.effect: Exact probability of immediate no-legal-move loss after the next spawn, only with two CAP and <=3 empty cells; strengths .5/1.
risk.cost: Additional execute_move checks are outside the existing positions counter; judge wall time/depth, not positions alone.

screen.order: rotate all seven arms by seed; strictly serial

selection: most goals; ties baseline first, then lower measured choose-wall/completed-move, then declared arm order

control.order: alternate first label by seed, serial even when both labels use baseline

criterion: nonbaseline finalist goals>baseline goals AND exact paired one-sided p<=0.05 AND zero limits; otherwise retain baseline. Actual choose-wall cost within +/-10% is reported separately, never assumed from the nominal budget.
stop: after all seven predetermined arms: local_plateau only if neither round1 nor round2 improves previous best goal count; otherwise bounded_neighborhood_exhausted. Both labels refer only to this fixed bounded neighborhood, never global optimum. No weights tuned on control.
scope: offline modeled Bonk only, pure formulas without ML/training/fit; spawn-stage rules remain assumptions; nominal10ms is not actual-cost equality and does not establish10s/phone win-rate; extra risk move checks are absent from the legacy positions counter; no tuning on control
